event_summary: A thin rod-like object moves near the right-side block row, after which the right-side blocks fall while the duck and left-side blocks remain upright.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a yellow duck-shaped toy centered on a wooden tabletop, with several small upright rectangular blocks arranged in a row on each side. A black round object sits behind the right-side blocks, and a thin light-colored rod is visible near it. During the video, the rod changes position toward the right-side row. The far-right black block on the right side tilts, followed by the neighboring right-side blocks leaning and falling into a cluster. By the end, the right-side blocks are slanted or lying on the tabletop, while the duck and the left-side row appear unchanged.

reasons: The duck, both block rows, the tabletop, and the black round object are visible.
The right-side blocks are upright before the visible falling event.
No scene cut is visible at the start.
